intro: Ask about leads, spend, speed to lead, the sales floor, AI or content. Answers come from the demo company's data.
suggestions: How did paid media do this week?
Which market has the lowest cost per set?
Which reps are below the floor average?
How accurate are the AI answers?
fallback: That one is outside this demo script. Try one of the suggestions.

entries.q: How did paid media do this week?
entries.answer:
Ad spend was **{{ad_spend@last7}}** over the last 7 days, down 4% on the week before.
Google Ads $26,194, Meta $15,833, Microsoft Ads $5,304 went through the three ad platforms; the rest is agency fees and offline media.
That spend sat against {{gross_revenue@last7}} of revenue, a MER of {{mer@last7}}.
follow_ups: What is our MER this week?

entries.q: Which campaign is the weakest?
entries.answer:
Over the last 14 days **LH Pro | Harborview | Search | Trade** (Google Ads) cost $118.51 per conversion on $3,072 of spend, the highest of any lead-generating campaign above $3,000. The best was LH | Regional | Retargeting at $14.29. Awareness video is left out of this ranking.
A pause or a budget cut here frees money for the winners.
follow_ups: Which market has the lowest cost per set?

entries.q: Which campaign is working best?
entries.answer: **LH | Regional | Retargeting** is the most efficient campaign over the last 14 days at $14.29 per conversion on $6,513 of spend.

entries.q: How many leads did we get yesterday?
entries.answer: **{{leads@yesterday}} leads** yesterday, down 1% on the same day last week. Of those leads, {{sets@yesterday}} appointments were set, and the day closed with {{sales@yesterday}} sales.
follow_ups: How is the funnel this week?

entries.q: What is our cost per lead?
entries.answer: Cost per lead is **{{cost_per_lead@last7}}** over the last 7 days (down 2% on the prior week): {{ad_spend@last7}} of ad spend over {{leads@last7}} leads.
follow_ups: What is our MER this week?

entries.q: What is our MER this week?
entries.answer: MER is **{{mer@last7}}** over the last 7 days: {{gross_revenue@last7}} of revenue on {{ad_spend@last7}} of ad spend. The prior week was 5.0x.

entries.q: Are we on pace this month?
entries.answer: Booked revenue is **{{gross_revenue@mtd}}** month to date, through Oct 24, against a monthly goal of $1,480,000. The goal expects about $1,144,906 by now, so we are at 89% of pace.

entries.q: How is the funnel this week?
entries.answer:
Last 7 days: **{{leads@last7}} leads**, {{sets@last7}} appointments set, {{issued@last7}} issued, {{meetings@last7}} meetings held and **{{sales@last7}} sales**.
Set rate {{set_rate@last7}} (28.7% the week before); close rate {{close_rate@last7}}.

entries.q: Which market has the lowest cost per set?
entries.answer:
Over the last 7 days **Sunvale** is the cheapest at $65 per set (74 sets) and **Harborview** the most expensive at $87.
Moving budget toward the cheaper market is the first lever.

entries.q: Which market closes best?
entries.answer: Over 28 days **Lakemont** closes best at 13.8% of issued appointments, and Riverbend lowest at 10.9%. Company close rate over the same days is {{close_rate@last28}}.

entries.q: What is the set rate?
entries.answer: Set rate is **{{set_rate@last7}}** over the last 7 days against 28.7% the week before: {{sets@last7}} appointments set from {{leads@last7}} leads.
follow_ups: What is the connect rate on the floor?

entries.q: What is the connect rate on the floor?
entries.answer: The floor connected **{{connect_rate@last7}}** of {{dials@last7}} dials over the last 7 days (prior week 13.7%), with about 26 reps on each open day.
follow_ups: Which reps are below the floor average?

entries.q: Which reps are below the floor average?
entries.answer: The three lowest connect rates over 14 days: **Remy C.** 8.3% on 701 dials, **Nico F.** 8.8% on 624 dials, **Kendall J.** 8.9% on 586 dials. The floor average is 13.7%, so these are the coaching candidates.
follow_ups: What is the connect rate on the floor?

entries.q: Which source's leads close best?
entries.answer: Over 28 days **Referral** closes best at 24.3% of meetings held (337 meetings). The weakest is Microsoft Ads (Agency) at 9.4%.

entries.q: How is direct mail doing?
entries.answer: Over 28 days direct mail produced **624 leads** and 152 sets on $21,344 of spend, $140 per set. Responses land over the ten days after each Tuesday drop.

entries.q: How is regional TV doing?
entries.answer: Regional TV over 28 days: **468 leads**, 112 sets, $17,412 of spend, $155 per set. Four markets carry flights, four weeks on and one off.

entries.q: How accurate are the AI answers?
entries.answer: Of 2,736 answers a reviewer graded in the last 7 days, **94.0%** were right. The AI answered 88.2% of 5,751 questions itself, handed off 7.0% and declined 4.7%.

entries.q: What does the AI cost?
entries.answer: AI workloads made 55,318 calls in the last 7 days. At vendor list price that work would cost **$551**; it actually cost $193, a saving of $358. Month to date the saving is $1,192.

entries.q: How healthy are the loops?
entries.answer: The scheduled loops, AI seats and playbooks ran **2,247 times** in the last 7 days; 99.69% succeeded and 7 failed. One loop, the creative library sync, has not fired in two days and is flagged on the health page.

entries.q: Where are we against the marketing cost target?
entries.answer: All-in marketing cost is **{{marketing_cost_pct@mtd}}** of net revenue month to date against a target of 28%. Last month closed at {{marketing_cost_pct@mom}}.

entries.q: Where does the month land?
entries.answer: Pacing the share of a month normally booked by today, the month lands near **$1.2M**, somewhere between $1.11M and $1.29M. The goal is $1.48M.
follow_ups: Are we on pace this month?

entries.q: What is in the content pipeline?
entries.answer: The library holds **37 pieces**: 19 approved, 12 posted, 1 in review and 5 in draft. The edit crew has 1 cuts in progress.

entries.q: Are there consent exceptions open?
entries.answer: Four consent items are open: one failed replay job, one capture held briefly, one failed text and one ambiguous stop waiting on a person. None is past its limit; the ambiguous stop is the one that needs a decision today.

entries.q: How fast does the AI respond?
entries.answer: The median full answer takes **1.9 seconds** end to end over the last 7 days, inside the 3.5 second budget. Open knowledge gaps: 4.
follow_ups: How accurate are the AI answers?

entries.q: What changed this week?
entries.answer: Leads were down 2%, ad spend down 4% and revenue down 15%. MER moved from 5.0x to {{mer@last7}}. The floor connect rate held at {{connect_rate@last7}}.
follow_ups: How did paid media do this week?

entries.q: Which market is behind on leads?
entries.answer: **Pinecrest** is furthest behind: 550 leads in the last 7 days against 605 the week before (-9%). **Sunvale** is furthest ahead at +12%. Across all markets there were {{leads@last7}} leads.
follow_ups: Which market has the lowest cost per set?

entries.q: How many appointments did the AI book?
entries.answer: None. The AI phone line does not book appointments. After hours it answers the call, captures the caller's name, address and need, and emails the team a summary the next morning. A person on the call floor sets the appointment.
follow_ups: How accurate are the AI answers?

entries.q: Does the AI phone answer calls during the day?
entries.answer: No. Daytime calls go to the call floor. The AI phone line covers after-hours calls, and the website chat answers visitors around the clock and emails the team the full conversation for leads and complaints.
follow_ups: What is the connect rate on the floor?
